Bettina, I can't set up the recurring Monday 08:00 digest from here. Jobs I schedule run locally and don't post into Slack, so I haven't created one. I've replied to you in the thread with the same explanation and a correction.

What I can do now is post a one-off 'Coastal week ahead' digest in #coastal-team when you ask. It would cover #coastal-team and #coastal-random. It would leave out money terms (rates, discounts, contract values, invoices), because Kwame and Sofia can see this channel and those figures only go to Anselm, June and the account owner. For a recurring post, your workspace admin would need to set one up.
